label: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION FEEDBACK — entirely fictional, not public opinion
disclosure: All demo-v1-* participant IDs in this batch are fictional. Counts and voices are illustrative, not representative. Explain synthetic origin in the demo presentation whenever showing these results. Existing feedback is not reclassified as synthetic.
conditions: Every generated submission has condition:null. Preserve total_conditions and the entire condition_clusters structure exactly.
presentation_context: Ordinary comments display in Overview Comments. Result panels do not themselves label this batch as synthetic; include the disclosure when presenting.
comment_style: Mostly serious, varied voices and lengths, fragments and informal spelling, with a small minority of exaggerated objections. Fictional personas are not demographic evidence.

proposals.audience_assumptions: Small local heritage audience at Queen East and Parliament, with nearby households, commercial workers, passers-by and wider heritage interest. Hundreds of immediate neighbours and workers plus a broader heritage audience is only a fictional planning scale, not a researched population count. This is an amendment to existing designation reasons and attributes, not an assumed demolition or change of use.

proposals.audience_assumptions: Citywide administrative policy with a more focused audience of second-hand goods and jewellery workers, entertainment operators, nearby residents and general business-policy interest. Use citywide reach with sector-specific participation, not an invented business or population count. Business connections receive meaningful weight, with distinct views on hours, register formats, the nightclub definition and videotape-store licensing repeal.

rerun_behavior: An identical second run was verified without writes or duplicates. For future changes, compare final submissions against live records first; temporary one-off scripts were removed.

verification_summary.initial_persistence: One MongoDB transaction inserted only this batch and updated only its six proposal aggregates.
verification_summary.condition_comparison: total_conditions and complete condition_clusters matched baseline effective display values exactly; every new condition is null; all six still have zero conditions.
verification_summary.baseline: All six initially had zero feedback and zero conditions. Before-state snapshots were retained until read-back and UI checks passed, then removed under queue cleanup rule 9.

unrelated_activity.handling: Concurrent Labatt/River and unrelated feedback changes were detected and preserved. No attempt to restore historical state; Batch 3 writes target only its six IDs. Exact unrelated feedback field changes cannot be reconstructed from snapshot hashes.

cleanup: After persistence, read-back, exact condition comparisons, generator reproducibility, duplicate prevention and all six UI checks passed, temporary scripts, baseline and standalone audit/verification reports were deleted. MongoDB records were not removed.
